meta.title: OpenAPI Viewer - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Paste an OpenAPI 3.x definition in JSON or YAML to extract all endpoints automatically and generate a method/path/operation summary table.
desc: Paste an OpenAPI 3.x definition in JSON or YAML to extract all endpoints automatically and generate a method/path/operation summary table.
ui.100: Parse failed: the content is neither valid JSON nor a recognizable YAML structure
ui.101: No endpoints found: JSON must include a paths node; YAML must include indented /path: lines with method lines such as get:/post:
ui.102:
Paste OpenAPI 3.x JSON or YAML content, e.g.:
openapi: 3.0.0
paths:
  /users:
    get:
      summary: 获取用户列表
      operationId: listUsers
